title: Memory safety bugs fixed in Firefox ESR 140.9.1, Thunderbird ESR 140.9.1, Firefox 149.0.2 and Thunderbird 149.0.2
description: Memory safety bugs were fixed in Firefox ESR 140.9.1, Thunderbird ESR 140.9.1, Firefox 149.0.2, and Thunderbird 149.0.2. The advisory references Microsoft Security Response Center but does not provide specific details about the vulnerabilities or their impact. No CVSS score or exploit information is available.
